findings.description: Design Brief specifies door and window alignment as 'host_centerline', meaning centered on their respective walls (south and north).

In the BIM JSON, opening-door-1 is placed at origin [0,0,0] relative to wall-south, and opening-window-1 is placed at origin [0,0,900] relative to wall-north, without explicit centering calculations, so door and window are not positioned at the center of the walls as required.
